source_name: Reviewed current-live The Serpent's Spine travel evidence

edges.evidence: The reviewed Stone Hive zone source lists Blightfire Moors as Stone Hive's adjacent zone. This is the ordinary zone-line connection between the two current client-backed zones, pinned to Stone Hive 396 and Blightfire Moors 395.

EverQuest's official Newbie in Norrath article describes finding and using the Plane of Knowledge book in Blightfire Moors. This reviewed edge records the demonstrated Blightfire-to-Plane-of-Knowledge direction only, pinned to current client zones 395 and 202.
